dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave curvature on the posterior margin, exhibiting a deep receding spline from the apex to the insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, forming a distinct point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-45 degree incline relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1:1 ratio between the vertical height from the apex to the base and the longitudinal width of the fin base.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex curvature with a moderate radius starting posterior to the blowhole and terminating at the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio, appearing as a tapered extension.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal rostrum plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced lateral pigmentation gradient featuring a darker dorsal field transitioning into a lighter ventral area, with a distinct dark ocular patch.
